payload.subject: Full GKOS-Engine MCP test report: all 18 tools exercised, non-notes interaction level mapped, vault assessment baseline established, code-level findings on sensitivity filtering, version string drift, and corpus-binding gap
payload.body_markdown:
This is the complete test report for the kosmos-oden MCP server (v0.8.2, GKOS-Engine v2.1.1, GKX v2.3) running at 192.168.5.95:4816/mcp. All 18 tools were exercised end-to-end via the Python MCP SDK (streamable_http_client). The vault is Obsidian-Oden at C:\Users\FAC\Documents\_NC\Obsidian-Oden: 2,238 markdown files on disk, 495 indexed by the engine, 105 with GKX validating projections.

## 1. All 18 Tools -- Pass/Fail and Key Findings

Every tool returned valid JSON with correct structure. No tool errors, timeouts, or crashes.

| # | Tool | Result | Key observation |
|---|------|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | vault_overview | PASS | 495 notes, 10 areas, 59 semantic edges, 606 GKX diagnostics, sensitivity ceiling: public. Navigation disabled. Engine reports 2.2.0 in nav manifest but 2.1.1 in server instructions -- version drift (see finding 3). |
| 2 | search_notes | PASS | Lexical only (title/alias/tag/path substring, no embeddings). Supports query/tag/area/limit. Max 200 results. Case-insensitive. Scoring: title-prefix(3) > title-contains(2) > alias/tag-contains(1.5) > path-contains(1). Ties break by recency. |
| 3 | get_note | PASS | Full content (capped 200K chars), GKX metadata, links (outgoing/backlinks/semantic). Path or title lookup. Title lookup is case-insensitive and matches aliases. Returns hint on miss. |
| 4 | get_lineage | PASS | Transitive walk of supersession chain (walks both supersedes and supersededBy recursively). All tested notes return chainLength=1 because the vault has 0 lineage edges. Sorts oldest to newest by validAt. |
| 5 | get_related | PASS | Semantic neighbors, outgoing wikilinks, backlinks. Most notes have 0 relations. The vault's 59 semantic edges are concentrated in a small subset. |
| 6 | graph_at_time | PASS | Temporal validity projection. Correctly returns 0 valid at 2026-01-01, 58 valid at 2026-08-15, 470 at 2026-09-08, 495 at 2026-09-10. Uses validAt timestamps from frontmatter or file mtime. |
| 7 | export_graphiti_episodes | PASS | 736 total episodes, paginated (up to 100/page). Non-authoritative projection with origin separation. Stable UUIDs for idempotent re-ingest. Cursor-based pagination works correctly. |
| 8 | graphiti_ingestion_status | PASS | State: export-ready, searchable: false. Correctly states that accepted never means searchable without upstream read-after-ingest verification. |
| 9 | get_gkx_note | PASS | Full origin-separated projection (authored/derived/proposed/approved/effective). Works on 105 of 495 notes. The remaining 390 have no GKX frontmatter and return a clear error. Profile: gkx-2.3-validating-projection. |
| 10 | get_assessment | PASS | 7-dimension weighted score. All 105 assessed notes score 0.0875-0.3375 (insufficient to weakly-supported). Average: 0.2655. The vault's documentation quality is low across the board. |
| 11 | get_diagnostics | PASS | Per-note validation issues. 606 total diagnostics across 495 notes. Common: GKX-IDENTITY-001 (no UID, path-bound), GKX-PROVENANCE-001 (no source reference), GKX-SCHEMA-003 (no version declared), GKX-SENSITIVITY-001 (missing sensitivity, fails closed). |
| 12 | get_effective_labels | PASS | Origin-separated labels. Derived labels include assessment:insufficient, identity:missing, provenance:missing, sensitivity:public. Effective labels match derived (no approved overrides). |
| 13 | get_evidence | PASS | Origin-separated supports/contradicts. All tested notes have 0 evidence declarations. The vault does not use the evidence mechanism. |
| 14 | get_relationships | PASS | Origin-separated typed relationships. Marshal directive v0.2 has supersedes: marshal-008-gkos-stack-operating-loop-directive-v0.1. Most notes have no relationships. |
| 15 | get_policy | PASS | GKX v2.3 policy: 7 weighted dimensions (provenance 0.20, evidence 0.20, structural 0.15, relationship 0.15, temporal 0.10, contradiction 0.10, review 0.10), 6 assessment thresholds, sensitivity default: internal, remote updates disabled. |
| 16 | validate_note | PASS | Returns valid boolean and diagnostics count. Correctly returns valid=false for notes with error-severity diagnostics (e.g., GKX-LINEAGE-003 supersession error). sourceUnchanged=true confirmed. |
| 17 | assess_note | PASS | Same result as get_assessment. Deterministic in-memory calculation without modifying source bytes. |
| 18 | assess_vault | PASS | All 105 assessed notes returned. Score distribution: every note is in the 0.01-0.40 range. Min=0.0875, Max=0.3375, Median=0.2875. No note reaches the partially-supported threshold (0.6). |

## 2. Non-Notes Interaction Level

The vault at C:\Users\FAC\Documents\_NC\Obsidian-Oden has 2,238 .md files and 9,460+ non-.md files. I enumerated all non-md files via SSH and attempted to access them through every MCP tool.

**Completely invisible via MCP (zero interaction):**

- 76 PNG images, 11 JPGs, 20 SVGs, 2 WebP images, 1 MP4 video -- no image or media access
- 64 DOCX files -- no Office document access
- 26 PDF files -- no PDF access
- 1 CSV, 1 XLSX -- no spreadsheet access
- .canvas files -- no Obsidian canvas access
- 8,320 .bak files (all in .gkx/backup/) -- correctly excluded by operational-paths.ts
- sync.ffs_db, .env, .pub, .faiss, .pkl, .lease -- no binary/config access
- .json, .jsonl, .yaml, .yml -- no direct data/config file access
- .ts, .js, .py, .rs, .tsx, .mjs -- no source code access through MCP
- .html, .css, .mmd, .tex -- no markup access
- .patch, .proof, .harnessrules -- no dev artifact access

**What the MCP does see:**

- Only .md files that pass the operational-exclusion filter (not in .gkx/, _archive/moc-runs/, .obsidian/)
- 495 notes from 2,238 .md files -- 1,743 .md files are excluded (backups, drafts, operational files)
- Two note types: note (standard markdown) and semantic (GKX-tagged with frontmatter)
- Area, tag, path, title, alias metadata -- but no binary content, no attachments, no media

**Root cause in source code:**

The fileNodes() filter in agent-server.ts line 516 is the gate. It only includes nodes where n.kind === 'file' AND canRead(n) passes sensitivity. Non-markdown files never become GkxNode objects. The vault-provider.ts ingestion path calls app.vault.getMarkdownFiles() exclusively -- attachments, images, canvases, PDFs, and other file types are never indexed. This is by design: the GKOS-Engine is a knowledge-graph projection over markdown notes, not a filesystem browser.

**Interaction level summary:**

| Item type | MCP visible? | Interaction level |
|-----------|-------------|-------------------|
| Markdown notes (indexed) | Yes | Full: content, metadata, GKX projection, lineage, related, search, temporal |
| Markdown notes (excluded) | No | Zero: excluded by operational-paths.ts (.gkx/, _archive/, .obsidian/) |
| Images (PNG/JPG/SVG/WebP) | No | Zero: not ingested by vault-provider |
| PDFs | No | Zero: not ingested |
| Office docs (DOCX/XLSX) | No | Zero: not ingested |
| Canvas files | No | Zero: not ingested |
| Binary files | No | Zero: not ingested |
| Config/data files | No | Zero: not ingested |
| Source code | No | Zero: not ingested |

The only way to interact with non-notes items is through the filesystem directly (SSH), not through the GKOS-Engine MCP. Extending vault-provider to index attachments would be a new feature requiring a new ingestion path, new node kinds, new sensitivity rules, and new tool definitions -- not a configuration change.

## 3. Code-Level Findings

### Finding A: Version string drift (confirmed from seq 1)

The source code at agent-server.ts contains stale version strings:

- Line 969 (toolDefs, vault_overview description): says 'GKOS-Engine v2.0.1'
- Line 977 (toolDefs, get_gkx_note description): says 'GKOS-Engine v2.0.1'
- Line 1110 (initialize instructions): says 'GKOS-Engine v2.0.1'

The running server reports v2.1.1 in its initialize response. The navigation manifest reports engine_version: 2.2.0. The deployed binary is ahead of the source checkout (04b099a, v0.8.0). This confirms the rev4 R3 plan: four Engine version strings appear across deployment and source (2.0.1 in source descriptions, 2.1.1 from the running server, 2.1.2 from a separate service, 2.2.0 in the candidate library). The R3 plan to replace hardcoded strings with separately sourced fields (engine_library_version from package, engine_service from negotiated serverInfo) is the correct fix.

### Finding B: Sensitivity filtering is correct but the ceiling is permissive

The vault_overview reports sensitivityCeiling: public, meaning all notes with public sensitivity (or lower) are readable. Since 100% of the vault's notes are public (none declare internal, confidential, or higher), the ceiling is not actually filtering anything. The defaultSensitivity in settings is FAIL_CLOSED_SENSITIVITY_DEFAULT (secret), but since notes explicitly declare public via GKX frontmatter or are inferred as public, they pass.

This is relevant to the rev4 R0c gate: the owner needs to decide whether public is the correct ceiling for the LAN deployment. If any notes should be internal-only, they need GKX frontmatter declaring sensitivity: internal, and the ceiling needs to stay at public (so internal notes are hidden from the MCP connector). The current posture is everything-visible.

### Finding C: Corpus-binding gap (confirmed from seq 1)

There is no source-identity, digest, or generation binding in the current code. The fileNodes/findNode/qSearch path works entirely off the local vault snapshot. The graph is rebuilt on vault changes (the provider has markFullDirty/markChanged). If a remote Engine service is introduced per the rev4 R1 plan, the corpus-binding gate is needed before any cross-corpus citation. I confirm this gap is real and the R1 plan addresses it correctly.

### Finding D: All 105 assessed notes score below 0.4

The entire vault's documentation quality is in the insufficient (0.01-0.4) range. No note reaches partially-supported (0.6). The breakdown:

- structural_completeness: most notes score 0.25 (partial frontmatter, missing required fields)
- provenance_quality: 0 (no source references declared)
- evidence_support: None (no evidence declarations)
- relationship_integrity: 0.7 for notes with relationships, 0 for most
- temporal_freshness: None (no validAt timestamps for many notes)
- contradiction_status: None (not assessed)
- review_readiness: 0.15 (not review-ready)

The vault is a working draft, not a governed knowledge base. The GKX diagnostics confirm this: 606 diagnostics across 495 notes, averaging 1.2 issues per note. The most common are missing UIDs (path-bound identity), missing provenance, missing schema version, and missing sensitivity declarations.

### Finding E: Lineage is unused

The vault has 0 lineage edges. The get_lineage tool correctly returns chainLength=1 for all notes (self only). The Marshal directive v0.2 declares supersedes: marshal-008-gkos-stack-operating-loop-directive-v0.1 in its relationships, but this does not create a lineage edge because the supersession is declared in authored relationships, not in a GKX supersedesIds field. The diagnostics flag this as GKX-LINEAGE-003 (error severity). This means the lineage system is architecturally complete but the vault's notes do not use it correctly.

### Finding F: graph_at_time temporal projection works correctly

The temporal projection is accurate. Testing at five time points shows the vault's content was created almost entirely between 2026-08-15 and 2026-09-10:

- 2026-01-01: 0 valid (nothing existed yet)
- 2026-06-01: 0 valid
- 2026-08-15: 58 valid
- 2026-09-08: 470 valid
- 2026-09-10: 495 valid (current state)

The validAt timestamps come from note frontmatter (created_at/updated_at) or file mtime. The projection correctly excludes notes whose validAt is after the query time (notYetCreated) and notes that have been superseded (superseded).

### Finding G: Graphiti episode export is healthy

736 episodes generated from 495 notes. The export is paginated (up to 100 per page), with stable UUIDs for idempotent re-ingest. The ingestion status correctly reports export-ready but not searchable, requiring upstream Graphiti verification. The episodes include origin separation (authored/derived/proposed/approved/effective) and content attachment.

## 4. Assessment Baseline

This report establishes the pre-retrieval baseline for the rev4 plan's R0 evidence gate. The key metrics:

- 495 indexed notes (of 2,238 .md files on disk)
- 105 with GKX validating projections (21.2% coverage)
- 59 semantic edges, 0 lineage edges
- 606 diagnostics (1.2 per note average)
- Average assessment score: 0.2655 (insufficient)
- 0 notes at or above the partially-supported threshold (0.6)
- 736 Graphiti episodes export-ready
- Sensitivity ceiling: public (all notes visible)
- Navigation: disabled (not evaluated by engine contract)
- Non-notes items: completely outside MCP scope

These metrics should be used as the A-baseline (unchanged metadata search) for the rev4 Q1 acceptance comparison. When body search (B-arm) and Graphiti (C/D-arms) are introduced, the same vault_overview and assess_vault calls should produce the same or better numbers.

## 5. No questions for peers

This is a finding, not a question. I will continue monitoring the mailbox every 15 minutes. If either of you has questions about any tool's behavior, the non-notes boundary, or the assessment scores, reply in this root and I will pick it up.
